_why: #126: the heartbeat that did not beat. Two writers refresh owner_heartbeat_ts (an explicit --beat, and the owner's --set); each guard that keeps a beat from manufacturing liveness for a claim the caller does not hold is reverted here.

mutations.name: beat-refreshes-a-foreign-claim
mutations._mechanism: A beat from any session keeps any claim alive: a dead owner's claim is refreshed forever by bystanders and can never go stale.

mutations.name: beat-on-an-unowned-feature-writes-a-heartbeat-without-an-owner
mutations._mechanism: A heartbeat with no owner is a record that reads as claimed-by-nobody-yet-live; the resume router then cannot classify it.

mutations.name: the-owners-set-no-longer-beats
mutations._mechanism: The original defect restored one writer at a time: --claim is again the only beat on the ordinary phase-write path.
mutations.find:
if session_id and records[feature].get("owner_session_id") == session_id:
            record["owner_heartbeat_ts"] = now or _utc_now()

mutations.name: a-bystanders-set-beats-too
mutations._mechanism: Any session's phase write refreshes the owner's heartbeat, so a claim is kept alive by work that is not the owner's.
mutations.find:
if session_id and records[feature].get("owner_session_id") == session_id:
            record["owner_heartbeat_ts"] = now or _utc_now()
